fields.description: Bugatti Residences by Binghatti is the two brands’ residential collaboration in Business Bay. Its curved architecture draws on the French Riviera, with Riviera Mansion residences and a separate Sky Mansion penthouse collection. Layouts and services vary between individual homes.

reviewCoverage.identity: Developer microsite and Bugatti brand-partner 2023 unveiling verified; Dubai Business Bay project, not announced Miami residences.
reviewCoverage.location: Business Bay explicitly confirmed by brand partner.
reviewCoverage.residences: Brochure names two-bedroom Cannes, three-bedroom St Tropez, four-bedroom Monaco, five- and eight-bedroom Sky Mansion designs. Range does not imply six- or seven-bedroom categories.
reviewCoverage.areas: Five official microsite unquantified plans viewed; branded mirror numerical panels 15,24,26,28,30,32–35 visually inspected. Eight-bedroom multi-level totals conflict and are not combined.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Brand-partner amenities distinguished from selected penthouse car-lift rights and chargeable services.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Current developer collection advertises AED 19.4m; portal precise 19.5m/rounded20m differs. Current unit offer unverified.
reviewCoverage.payment: Portal 70% construction/30% handover totals 100; no own dated primary payment document retrieved.
reviewCoverage.handover: Older branded brochure Q4 2026 differs from portal August 2027; headline unset pending current primary confirmation.
reviewCoverage.documents: Current microsite contains plan images without numerical areas. Original branded 45-page brochure retrieved on broker domain and labelled accordingly, not claimed developer-hosted.

overview: The brand’s launch release describes 171 Riviera Mansions and 11 Sky Mansion penthouses. The original brochure identifies two-, three-, four-, five- and eight-bedroom designs; bespoke penthouses require their own approved drawings.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai. No fixed travel-time or every-home view guarantee is adopted.
research.priceNote: Binghatti’s branded collection advertises from AED 19.4m. Property Finder gives AED 19.5m in its FAQ and a rounded AED 20m headline. Different references are not a selected-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 70% during construction and 30% on handover. A deposit breakdown, dated calendar and current signed terms were not verified from primary documents.
research.handoverNote: The original branded brochure forecasts Q4 2026; Property Finder now forecasts August 2027, with 30 August in its timeline. No current primary source resolves this difference; no headline completion date is assigned.
